description: This is a unit test class for the PersonController in a Spring Boot application. It uses JUnit, Mockito, Spring MVC Test framework, and Jackson to test the REST endpoints of the controller, mocking dependencies such as PersonService and PersonMapper. The tests simulate CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) for Person entities via HTTP requests and verify responses.

classes.name: PersonControllerUnitTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the REST endpoints of PersonController in isolation, using mocked dependencies.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and defines behavior for mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: testCRUD
methods.description: Performs a sequence of tests for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting a Person entity through HTTP requests, verifying responses.
